decision.changed_angle: July11 secondary introduces Reuters July10 announcement that Trump will address the July27 Bitcoin conference. This is a new dated political visibility catalyst since the prior July9 appearance, which concerned German-government supply anxiety; July8 concerned repayment start and coping attention, and July5 led on a fall/MtGox supply worry. The new entry keeps the appearance prospective and assumes no policy commitment or price response. BTC does not repeat the full lead and the political event supplies a distinct falsification risk.
